description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for interacting with the Google Sheets API, including creating, retrieving, updating, and managing spreadsheet data and ranges. It also exports a factory function to generate specific tools based on requested actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleSheetsTool
classes.description: A base class for Google Sheets API tools, providing request handling and authorization.

classes.name: CreateSpreadsheetTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new Google Spreadsheets.

classes.name: GetSpreadsheetTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a Google Spreadsheet by ID.

classes.name: UpdateSpreadsheetTool
classes.description: Tool for updating properties of an existing Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: GetValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving values from a specified range in a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: UpdateValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for updating values in a specified range in a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: AppendValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for appending values to a range in a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: ClearValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for clearing values from a specified range in a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: BatchGetValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving multiple ranges of values from a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: BatchUpdateValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for updating multiple ranges of values in a Google Spreadsheet.

classes.name: BatchClearValuesTool
classes.description: Tool for clearing multiple ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.

methods.name: makeGoogleSheetsRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Google Sheets API with proper headers and error handling.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Each specific tool class implements this method to perform its API operation.
